caption.instagram:
How the game-day final call works 📲

1️⃣ A starter gets ruled out close to kickoff, and he's still in your lineup
2️⃣ AllFantasy checks your bench for the best swap, flex spots included
3️⃣ You get one text: who's out, who to start, and a link to fix it

One text per player. Only when it matters. Turn it on in Settings → Notifications. Link in bio.
